hypothesis: Les prix 1X2, total 2.5 et handicap du meme bookmaker peuvent apporter une information complementaire a la calibration d'un seul marche.
refit: once_before_first_match_of_each_test_season; prior seasons AND match_date < first_test_date - embargo
model: softmax(log_market_probability + standardized_features @ beta), last outcome reference, ridge toward zero
calibration_features: own-market log probability ratios and overround
cross_market_extra_features: other-market probability ratios, overrounds, handicap line, squared 1X2 imbalance, squared line, total-logit x imbalance, total-logit x line

policy.sensitivity_selection: same bets as primary; never reselect after changing friction

uncertainty.bootstrap: circular moving blocks of 3 consecutive calendar months including no-bet months
uncertainty.interpretation: Bonferroni within these four tests only; cannot correct unknown prior searches; not posterior probability of profit

limitations: No exact intraday quote timestamp or accepted stake
Preclosing columns are not guaranteed simultaneous across markets
Prices are not proven available on user's own bookmaker
Historical data already used in earlier research
This test cannot validate or reject every cross-market approach
